body.en: DRAFT — v3 Thirteen people died in a drug trial that was officially halted for "poor recruitment". Nine of the thirteen deaths were later reclassified as "unrelated to the trial". body.en: DRAFT — v1 Šimunić signed nine death certificates for a trial whose protocol he had co-authored. Nobody asked him how that was possible, because nobody outside that building knew those two things were the same person. Across the whole paragraph, in yellow: "this will not clear legal. But it is true."

body.en: # Chronology **14.03.2016** — first day of the substudy. (Ana has a photograph from that day.) **06.2016** — A.P. dies. The only death NOT reclassified. **11.2016** — substudy halted, officially over recruitment. **12.2016** — nine reclassifications, all within three weeks, all the same signature. **03.2019** — Ana P. (the other Ana, the reporter) gets the list. Dies before she can file it. **this week** — N. agrees to talk. The last line was added in a different colour.

body.hr: IZVORI — nikad puna imena u ovoj datoteci N. — arhiva, pristup, jedini koji je pristao ići na zapis. Boji se, i ima pravo. D. — potvrdio protokol, neće se potpisati. M. — odbio. Dvaput. Ž. — poslao mi je jednu rečenicu i obrisao broj. Ispod svega: „ako ovo netko drugi čita, nijedan od njih nije ti dao ovu datoteku.“
body.en: SOURCES — never full names in this file N. — the archive, the access, the only one who agreed to go on record. He is frightened, and he is right to be. D. — confirmed the protocol, will not put his name to it. M. — refused. Twice. Ž. — sent me one sentence and deleted his number. Underneath all of it: "if somebody else is reading this, not one of them gave you this file."

body.hr: PRAVNA PROVJERA — bilješke uz nacrt v2 1. „Ubio ih je“ — ne. Nikada. Ni u jednoj verziji. 2. „Potpisao je devet prekvalifikacija“ — da, ako imate presliku sva tri potpisa. 3. „Zataškavanje“ — ne dok netko to ne kaže na zapis. 4. Ime izvora ne ide u tekst ni pod kojim uvjetima, ni sa suglasnošću. Rukom, na margini, njezinim rukopisom: „4 je jedini savjet koji ću poslušati bez svađe.“
body.en: LEGAL CHECK — notes against draft v2 1. "He killed them" — no. Never. Not in any version. 2. "He signed nine reclassifications" — yes, if you hold copies of all three signatures. 3. "Cover-up" — not until somebody says it on the record. 4. The source's name does not go in the piece under any circumstances, consent or no consent. By hand in the margin, in her writing: "4 is the only advice I will take without arguing."

body.hr: PITANJA — za Š., pisano, s rokom od 48 sati 1. Jeste li bili suautor protokola podstudije? 2. Jeste li potpisali prekvalifikaciju devet smrti u toj istoj podstudiji? 3. Je li itko izvan ustanove o tome obaviješten? 4. Zašto A.P. nije prekvalificirana? Na dnu, sitno: „poslati tek kad N. bude na sigurnom. Ne prije.“
body.en: QUESTIONS — for Š., in writing, 48 hours to respond 1. Were you a co-author of the substudy protocol? 2. Did you sign the reclassification of nine deaths in that same substudy? 3. Was anybody outside the institution informed? 4. Why was A.P. not reclassified? At the bottom, small: "send only once N. is somewhere safe. Not before."

body.hr: Što ako griješim. Ako griješim, uništila sam čovjeku život zbog devet potpisa koje je možda potpisao jer mu je netko rekao da potpiše. Ako sam u pravu, a šutim, onda ih je trinaest i nitko za njih nikad neće čuti. Ovo nije hrabrost. Ovo je aritmetika. Datoteka je otvarana četrdeset i jedan put.
body.en: What if I am wrong. If I am wrong, I have destroyed a man over nine signatures he may have signed because somebody told him to sign them. If I am right and I say nothing, then there are thirteen of them and nobody will ever hear about it. This is not courage. This is arithmetic. The file has been opened forty-one times.

text.hr: Sljedećih dana bit ću slabo dostupna. Piši mi, molim te, nemoj zvati. Javim se kad uhvatim vremena.
text.en: I’ll be hard to reach for the next few days. Please text rather than call. I’ll reply when I get a moment.

text.hr: Sljedećih dana bit ću slabo dostupna. Piši mi, molim te, nemoj zvati. Javim se kad uhvatim vremena.
text.en: I’ll be hard to reach for the next few days. Please text rather than call. I’ll reply when I get a moment.

text.hr: Sljedećih dana bit ću slabo dostupna. Piši mi, molim te, nemoj zvati. Javim se kad uhvatim vremena.
text.en: I’ll be hard to reach for the next few days. Please text rather than call. I’ll reply when I get a moment.

text.hr: Ne mogu sad o nama. Daj mi tjedan dana da ovo završim, pa ću biti prisutna koliko god hoćeš.
text.en: I can’t do us right now. Give me a week to finish this and then I’ll be as present as you want.

text.hr: Ako ti to nije dovoljno, razumjet ću i to.
text.en: If that isn’t enough for you, I’ll understand that too.
All right.

text.hr: Kupio sam onu rižu koju voliš. Dolaziš?
text.en: I bought that rice you like. Are you coming over?
Not tonight. Working.

text.hr: Radiš svaku večer već tri tjedna.
text.en: You have been working every night for three weeks.
I know. Give me a week.
Are you all right?
tomorrow
Lena?
Lena.

text.hr: Možeš mi vratiti plavu zdjelu kad stigneš?
text.en: Can you bring back my blue bowl when you have time?

text.hr: Kod mene je zelena. Plavu ima Ivana.
text.en: I have the green one. Ivana has the blue one.
The reservation code is 4821.
For badminton?

text.hr: Da. Termin od prošle subote, već je istekao.
text.en: Yes. Last Saturday’s slot; it has already expired.
I left the key in an envelope.

text.hr: Hvala. To je ključ biciklističkog lokota, onaj mali?
text.en: Thanks. The little bike-lock key?
That one. Nothing dramatic.

text.hr: Paket nije kod mene. Pitaj na drugom katu.
text.en: I don’t have the parcel. Try the second floor.

text.hr: Našla sam ga. Filteri za usisavač.
text.en: Found it. Vacuum filters.
Are we still exchanging the book?

text.hr: Da, kuharica je na polici kraj vrata.
text.en: Yes, the cookbook is on the shelf by the door.
The repair shop replied.
Just the washing-machine seal, fortunately.

text.hr: Ne s ovog broja više. Kupite drugi.
text.en: Not from this number any more. Buy another one.

text.hr: Treba mi popis potpisnika. Samo imena.
text.en: I need the list of signatories. Names only.
Do you know what you are asking for?
Yes.

text.hr: Sutra u devet. Ne dolazite autom.
text.en: Nine tomorrow. Do not come by car.
Do not answer the landline.

body.hr:
„Istina koja ubija“ — melodramatično.
„Trinaest“ — ništa ne govori.
Početi činjenicom, ne pridjevom.
body.en:
“The truth that kills” — melodramatic.
“Thirteen” — says nothing.
Start with a fact, not an adjective.
